column5: The queue read this as a maintenance setting the label does not cover, and both halves of that are wrong. NCT03345823 is protocol M14-430, U-ENDURE, 'A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Maintenance and Long-Term Extension Study ... in Subjects With Crohn''s Disease Who Completed the Studies M14-431 or M14-433', which are U-EXCEL and U-EXCEED, the two induction studies. It is the maintenance half of the registrational programme that won the approval, not a setting outside it, and the FDA approved Crohn''s disease as efficacy supplement 15 to NDA 211675 on 2023-05-18. The label reads 'RINVOQ is indicated for the treatment of adults with moderately to severely active Crohn''s disease (CD) who have had an inadequate response or intolerance to one or more TNF blockers' and its dosing is an induction course followed by maintenance (DailyMed setid 2966aec7-2ef0-923c-d8ff-fe1a957bf095, SPL v101, effective 2026-07-15)

Three facts, each sufficient on its own. The label is limited in none of the ways the row assumed: 'ALTUVIIIO is indicated for use in adults and pediatric patients with hemophilia A (congenital factor VIII deficiency) for: Routine prophylaxis ...; On-demand treatment and control of bleeding episodes; Perioperative management of bleeding' (DailyMed setid 01411972-df40-4ccf-88f0-d3220e5abda9, SPL v11, effective 2026-10-26), so neither age nor setting is outside it. The study enrols inside it: NCT04644575 is 'Long-term Safety and Efficacy of Efanesoctocog Alfa (BIVV001) in Previously Treated Patients With Hemophilia A', n=261, with 'Number of participants with the occurrence of inhibitor development' as its primary, and previously treated patients in an extension are by definition already on the product. And the approval predates the study: BLA 125771, 2023-02-22

Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial'. It carries no prior-therapy restriction, so first line is covered, and section 14.1 rests it on SOHO-01 Group F, treatment-naive, n=69. SOHO-02 is that confirmatory trial, named in the approval letter as PMR 4933-1 with trial completion 04/2029. A Phase 2 of the GSK Vaccines Institute for Global Health's iNTS-TCV vaccine in 537 infants, every site in The Gambia (registry checked 2026-11-16), primary outcomes solicited reactions. Invasive nontyphoidal salmonella in infants has no US pool or price

A Phase 3 surveillance study of resistance-associated substitutions to baloxavir in about 1,100 children aged 3 weeks to 11 with influenza and of household transmission (registry checked 2026-11-16). Its primary outcomes are the share of participants with pre-treatment and treatment-emergent substitutions, which read out on resistance, not on efficacy, so the study does not move the label's age floor of 5 (data/assumptions/rog_xofluza.csv)

In October 2023 Beam's board approved a prioritisation under which it 'intends to explore partnership opportunities for continued development of select programs, including BEAM-201' (8-K 0001193125-23-258963; FY2024 10-K 0000950170-25-026076). No partner was announced, the study closed at 5 patients enrolled (registry, active not recruiting), and the FY2025 10-K (0001193125-26-065194) and Q2 2026 10-Q (0001193125-26-331541) no longer name BEAM-201

Sangamo filed for Chapter 11 on 2026-06-23 (Case 26-10989, D. Del.; 8-K 0001193125-26-278582) to sell its assets. ST-503 drew no winning bid at the 2026-08-10 auction (8-K 0001193125-26-347524, ex. 99.1), and its only study is suspended: 'Study is suspended while Sangamo seeks a new sponsor for the ST-503-101 study' (registry, updated 2026-11-03). The stock was delisted effective 2026-10-17 (8-K 0001193125-26-434171)

Worth nil: generic ticagrelor has been sold in the US since 2025-05-01 (FDA Paragraph IV list for NDA 22433, first marketing 2025-05-01; openFDA Drugs@FDA ANDAs 208584 Apotex 2025-05-01, 208576 Alembic 2025-05-02, 208537 InvaGen 2025-05-05, all marketed, queried 2026-11-16) and AstraZeneca reports Brilinta US revenue of $16m for the nine months to 2026-09-30, down 95%, 'Decline driven by generic entry in the US and Europe in Q2 2025' (6-K 0001654954-26-009256, filed 2026-10-30). The only Orange Book patent left, 10300065 to 2036, carries use codes U-2541 and U-2542 (60 mg after MI or ACS), so nothing protects a stroke use. CAPTIVA is academic, not AstraZeneca's: sponsor University of Florida, NINDS grant U01NS117450, AstraZeneca and Janssen collaborators, 1,683 US patients across 114 US sites, ticagrelor plus aspirin and rivaroxaban plus aspirin each against clopidogrel plus aspirin, primary completion 2027-01-31 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). The label already covers part of the population, 'to reduce the risk of stroke in patients with acute ischemic stroke (NIH Stroke Scale score <=5) or high-risk transient ischemic attack (TIA)' (DailyMed setid f7b3f443-e83d-4bf2-0e96-023448fed9a8, SPL 56). Draft pos 0.0 row in nil_rows.csv moves the readout to programme_stopped with this source

Worth nil, though the gap is real. The label excludes the population: 'Initiation with FARXIGA is not recommended in patients with an eGFR less than 25 mL/min/1.73 m2' (openFDA set 72ad22ae-efe6-4cd6-a302-98aaee423d69, version 49, effective 2026-06-03). But generic dapagliflozin was approved and launched on 2026-04-06 (openFDA Drugs@FDA ANDAs 211312 Sandoz, 211478 MSN, 211468 Aurobindo, 211470 Biocon, all marketed; FDA Paragraph IV list for NDA 202293, first marketing 2026-04-06, queried 2026-11-16), and AstraZeneca reports Farxiga US revenue of $795m for the nine months to 2026-09-30, down 36%, 'Multiple generics launched in Q2 2026' (6-K 0001654954-26-009256, filed 2026-10-30). RENAL LIFECYCLE reads out 2027-07, fifteen months after generic entry, is sponsored by University Medical Center Groningen (AstraZeneca and the Dutch Kidney Foundation collaborate) and has no US site: Australia, Belgium, Germany, the Netherlands, Singapore and Spain only, 1,750 patients, dapagliflozin 10 mg against placebo (registry, checked 2026-11-16). Draft pos 0.0 row in nil_rows.csv

SURMOUNT-MMO is an outcomes study inside the approved population, the Zepbound analogue of SELECT. Label: 'ZEPBOUND is indicated in combination with a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity: to reduce excess body weight and maintain weight reduction long term in adults with obesity or adults with overweight in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbid condition' (DailyMed setid 487cd7e7-434c-4925-99fa-aa80b1cc776b, SPL 40, openFDA effective 2026-08-28). Trial: BMI 27.0 or more, age 40 or more with established cardiovascular disease, or older adults with cardiovascular risk factors, diabetes excluded, 15,374 enrolled, primary outcome time to death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke, coronary revascularisation or heart failure event, primary completion 2027-10 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). A win adds a claim, not patients. The book already says so: lly_zepbound.csv carries Obesity base_pool_overlap_pct 1.0. THE ROW READS needs_layer ONLY BECAUSE OF A LINK DEFECT: catalyst 798 carries asset_indication_id 118, which is Mounjaro (asset 126) and Obesity, not Zepbound's own pair 133 (asset 138, indication 15). indication_layer.build is called on Mounjaro, which has no Obesity assumptions. Relinking catalyst 798 to pair 133 should make it already_approved or in_the_base; no seed row is needed

Oral Wegovy is approved: NDA 218316 (Wegovy tablets 1.5, 4, 9 and 25 mg), original approval 2025-12-22, five labelling supplements since (openFDA Drugs@FDA, queried 2026-11-16). Label: 'WEGOVY tablets are indicated in combination with a reduced calorie diet and increased physical activity: ... to reduce excess body weight and maintain weight reduction long term in adults with obesity, or in adults with overweight in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbid condition' (DailyMed setid ee06186f-2aa3-4990-a760-757579d8f77b, SPL 19, 2026-06-30). OASIS 5 enrols adults with BMI 30.0 or more, or 27.0 or more with at least one weight-related comorbidity, HbA1c below 6.5%, two oral doses against placebo, primary outcome relative change in body weight at week 60, 450 patients, primary completion 2028-02-22 (registry, checked 2026-11-16): the label's population word for word. nvo_wegovy.csv already carries Obesity base_pool_overlap_pct 1.0. SAME LINK DEFECT AS ZEPBOUND: catalyst 1106 carries asset_indication_id 121, which is Ozempic (asset 128) and Obesity, and Wegovy (asset 136) has no Obesity pair in asset_indications at all; the fix is a Wegovy/Obesity pair and a relink, not a seed row

A postmarketing safety and dosing requirement, not an expansion. NCT06568939 is AbbVie study M25-274 (registry org study id), which FDA imposed at approval as PMR 4844-2 under section 505(o): 'Complete clinical trial, Study M25-274 ... to further assess known serious risks with telisotuzumab vedotin including interstitial lung disease, ocular disorders, and other severe adverse reactions, evaluating alternative dosages (flat dosage 1.9 mg/kg Q2W vs flat dosage 1.6 mg/kg Q2W vs. 1.6 mg/kg -> 1.9 mg/kg Q2W dose up-titration)' (BLA 761384 approval letter, 2025-05-14, Reference ID 5590638, accessdata.fda.gov). Primary outcomes are adverse event rates (any grade, ILD, neuropathy, ocular, discontinuation, grade 5) plus ORR, three telisotuzumab arms, no comparator, 150 patients, primary completion 2028-02 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). It admits c-Met 25% or more 3+, wider than the label's 'high c-Met protein overexpression [>=50% of tumor cells with strong (3+) staining] ... who have received a prior systemic therapy' (DailyMed setid bc04f980-3957-4e35-ab81-8ec2ffe87215), but the study that verifies benefit and could widen the claim is M18-868, NCT04928846, PMR 4844-1, primary completion 2028-12. Price and discontinuation are therefore not pursued for this readout

A master protocol of two molecules and two diseases, not one readout. Subprotocol A is inebilizumab (3 or 4 doses) in biopsy-proven class III or IV lupus nephritis with inadequate response to at least one therapy; subprotocols B and C are blinatumomab (Blincyto) in SLE and refractory rheumatoid arthritis. Primary outcomes for subprotocol A are treatment-emergent and serious treatment-emergent adverse events to week 52; the efficacy primaries (complete renal response, DORIS remission, DAS28-CRP remission) belong to blinatumomab cohorts. Phase 2, open label, non-randomised, 220 patients across the protocol, 'Subprotocol A and B are no longer recruiting', and the 2028-08-06 primary completion is the whole platform's (registry, checked 2026-11-16). Amgen: 'A Phase 2 study of inebilizumab in autoimmune disease has completed enrollment of adults with SLE with nephritis' (Q3 2026 results, 8-K 0000318154-26-000153, 2026-11-03). Label: NMOSD (AQP4 positive), IgG4-related disease and generalised myasthenia gravis in adults (openFDA set 834db232-afb0-4dcf-93e0-009ce8245c20, version 11, 2026-09-21). The inebilizumab arm is an uncontrolled safety readout in nephritis, a narrower disease than the book's SLE pool, so the ASP price was not pursued

SHASTA-10 is 'A Phase 3 Open-Label Extension Study to Evaluate the Long-Term Safety and Efficacy of Plozasiran in Adults With Hypertriglyceridemia': single group, no masking, entry requires having 'Completed all required study visits per protocol in the parent study', primary outcome number of participants with treatment-emergent adverse events to month 24, 710 enrolled, primary completion 2028-07 (registry, sponsor study AROAPOC3-3006, checked 2026-11-16). The sHTG value rides on the parent studies, all completed: SHASTA-3 NCT06347003 (pcd 2026-06-12), SHASTA-4 NCT06347016 (2026-06-17) and MUIR-3 NCT06347133 (2026-06-01). Arrowhead 'has submitted a Supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) to the U.S. FDA and is currently preparing for a potential U.S. launch in sHTG in the second quarter of 2027', and 'In October 2026, the FDA granted entry into the STAR pilot program for the Company's sNDA for plozasiran for the treatment of sHTG' (FY2026 10-K 0000879407-26-000078, filed 2026-11-12). Label today: 'adjunct to diet to reduce triglycerides in adults with familial chylomicronemia syndrome (FCS)' (DailyMed setid 7fd37993-f85a-4af1-8bbe-133299f226ed, SPL 4). The gate is the sNDA decision, which the book has no catalyst for

A real but small expansion that cannot be priced from free sources. Outside the label: 'POMBILITI is indicated, in combination with Opfolda, for the treatment of adult patients with late-onset Pompe disease ... weighing >=40 kg and who are not improving on their current enzyme replacement therapy (ERT)' (DailyMed setid d77aa596-910d-516b-e053-2995a90a0839, SPL 8, 2026-08-17); ROSSELLA (ATB200-08) enrols IOPD aged 0 to under 18, 36 patients, open label, primary outcome infusion-associated reactions at 104 weeks, primary completion 2027-07 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). Sourced: US IOPD incidence 23 a year, 63 cases in 9,794,141 US newborns screened, 1 in 155,463 (Colburn and Lapidus, Front Pediatr 2024;11:1221140, PMID 38274468, PMC10810242) on 3,628,934 2024 births (NVSR 75-02); overlap 0.0; default ramp. Refused: prevalence (no free US survival of treated IOPD to 18), eligible_pct, penetration_peak_pct, discontinuation_pct, and net_price_per_patient (CMS 2024 holds 13 adult beneficiaries in each of Part B and Part D, and a 20 mg/kg drug cannot be priced for children without an age and weight mix). Partial draft in bmrn_pombiliti_rows.csv. Owner now correct: BioMarin completed the Amicus merger on 2026-04-27 (Amicus 8-K 0001140361-26-016968, Item 2.01)

A real expansion with a free pool and no free price. Outside the label: 'PALSONIFY is indicated for the treatment of adults with acromegaly who had an inadequate response to surgery and/or for whom surgery is not an option' (openFDA set 8a6d2ce0-a621-4ee7-983c-977cd948ff4d, version 3). CAREFNDR is a randomised, quadruple-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 of paltusotine 80 mg daily in carcinoid syndrome due to well-differentiated NETs, primary outcome flushing frequency at week 12, 141 patients, primary completion 2027-08 (registry, sponsor study CRN00808-12, checked 2026-11-16). Sourced: prevalence 32,168, the 171,321 US NET 20-year prevalence of 2014 (Dasari, JAMA Oncol 2017, PMID 28448665) times the 1,786 of 9,512 NETs with carcinoid syndrome at diagnosis (Halperin, Lancet Oncol 2017, PMID 28238592); incidence 4,457, 6.98 per 100,000 on 340,110,988 (Census V2024) times the same share; overlap 0.0; default ramp. Refused: net_price_per_patient (Crinetics sells at an unpublished WAC, reports no patients on drug, and Medicaid SDUD suppresses every national Palsonify row for 2025 Q4 and 2026 Q1), discontinuation_pct, eligible_pct, penetration_peak_pct. Partial draft in vrtx_palsonify_rows.csv. Owner now correct: Vertex completed the Crinetics merger on 2026-09-01 (Crinetics 8-K 0001140361-26-035195, Item 2.01; Form 15 2026-09-11)

MARITIME 3-J is a Phase 3 of maridebart cafraglutide at three doses against placebo in 279 adults, every site in Japan, with entry by the Japan Society for the Study of Obesity guideline (BMI ≥ 35 with one JASSO comorbidity, or 27 to 35 with two), primary outcome percent change in body weight at week 72, primary completion 2027-04-27 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). The book values US obesity, and the US gate is MARITIME-1 (NCT06858839, 2027-01-21), already priced on this asset; the ex-US value rides on exus_multiple, not on a Japanese filing. The registry indexes Overweight, Body Weight and Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2, none of which the condition 'Obesity Disease' matches

AZURE-CHINA is a Phase 2/3 of 432 participants, every site in China or Hong Kong: Part A's primary outcomes are AZD0780 plasma concentrations and PK parameters in 18 to 55 year olds, Part B's is relative change in LDL-C at 12 weeks, primary completion 2027-02-22 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). It seeks in China the LDL-C claim AZURE-LDL (NCT07000123) seeks in the US, and the book values the US. The registry indexes Dyslipidemias (D050171), which the condition 'Dyslipidaemia' misses only on spelling

MountainTAP-5 is a single-arm, open-label Phase 2 (254 planned, started 2026-07-27) of navlimetostat alone and in combinations in 'Advanced and/or Metastatic Solid Tumors With Homozygous MTAP Deletion', with brain cancer, melanoma, NSCLC and pancreatic cohorts; Part 1's primary outcome is objective response and Part 2's are dose-limiting toxicities and adverse events, primary completion 2028-08-15 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). The condition is 'Solid Tumors'. data/assumptions/bmy_navlimetostat.csv values first-line MTAP-deleted NSCLC and PDAC, gated by the randomised Phase 2/3s MountainTAP-29 (NCT07063745) and MountainTAP-30 (NCT07076121), and says 'Not modelled: the Phase 2 studies in pretreated NSCLC (MountainTAP-9) and other solid tumours'

'A Phase 2, Open-Label, Single-Center, Long-Term Immunogenicity Follow-Up Study of the GVGH altSonflex1-2-3 Shigella Vaccine 1, 2 and 3 Years After Vaccination in African Children', 179 participants. Every intervention reads 'No intervention is administered in this extension study': the vaccine was given in the parent studies H06_01TP (212149) and H06_02TP (219449), and the primary outcomes are serotype-specific anti-LPS IgG at 12, 24 and 36 months after the last parent-study dose; primary completion 2028-10-16 (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07320716, read 2026-11-16). GVGH is the GSK Vaccines Institute for Global Health and the population is African infants; no GSK filing names altSonflex (EDGAR full-text search, 0 hits, 2023 to 2026-11-16)

A Phase 2, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of subcutaneous LY3537021 on top of standard antiemetics in 204 adults receiving cisplatin or anthracycline-cyclophosphamide, primary outcome complete response in the delayed phase of chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting, primary completion 2026-12 (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07169851, read 2026-11-16). A GIPR monoagonist (ASCO 2026 abstract TPS855, doi:10.1200/JCO.2026.44.2_suppl.TPS855) and Lilly's own programme. Lilly files nothing on it: EDGAR full-text search for 'LY3537021' returns 0 hits, 2023-01-01 to 2026-11-16. No free source found in this search counts the US patients started on cisplatin or AC each year, no GIPR agonist is sold in any indication to give a price, and no Phase 3 or filing date exists to launch from, so pool, price and timing would all be invented. Re-checked 2026-11-27: EDGAR full-text search for 'LY3537021' still returns 0 hits across every form from 2026-01-01, and the Q3 2026 10-Q (0000059478-26-000108) does not name it. Still unpriced

PF-07104091 (tegtociclib, Pfizer's CDK2 inhibitor; Rallybio 424B3 0001193125-26-422924, Iambic 424B4 0001193125-26-422865). NCT04553133 is a 'Phase 1/2a dose escalation, finding and expansion study', 157 enrolled, active not recruiting, primary outcomes dose-limiting toxicities, adverse events, vital signs and QTc, primary completion 2026-12-31; the catalyst is named after one of its arms, 'monotherapy dose expansion (SCLC)' (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04553133, read 2026-11-16). No Phase 3 is registered and Pfizer's filings never name the molecule (EDGAR full-text search, 0 Pfizer hits 2023 to 2026-11-16), so neither the indication it would launch in nor a year can be cited. Rallybio's October 2026 prospectus still describes it as in Phase 1 dose escalation; no discontinuation is stated, so it is not a discontinued_programmes row

The Phase 3 of Moderna's H5 pandemic influenza vaccine, 4,050 adults, HAI immunogenicity at Day 43, primary completion 2027-01-28 (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07496450). data/assumptions/mrna_mrna_1018_h5.csv carries the probability legs and the company half and refuses on price: outside a pandemic an H5 vaccine is bought for government stockpiles by contract, and Moderna files no H5 supply or advance purchase agreement. Rechecked 2026-11-16: the Q3 2026 10-Q (0001682852-26-000197) does not mention mRNA-1018 or H5, and the 2026 8-Ks name only CEPI's up to $54.3mm of trial funding (0001682852-26-000007) and the Phase 3 start (0001682852-26-000057). A filed stockpile contract with doses and price would price it

GenTLE, uniQure's open-label Phase I/IIa of AMT-260 in refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy, primary endpoint safety at one year (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06063850). data/assumptions/qure_amt_260.csv carries pool, uptake, legs and company half and refuses on price on purpose: the 240,000 eligible US patients are two orders of magnitude beyond any one-time gene therapy price ICER lists, and no free source gives a price for this population. Rechecked 2026-11-16 in the Q3 2026 10-Q (0001104659-26-122367): no price, and 'In the third quarter of 2026, the Company completed enrollment in the second dose cohort of seven patients', so the one-year safety readout of the full study falls in 2027 and the registry's 2026-11-30 is likely to slip

Phase 3 VTE thromboprophylaxis after total knee arthroplasty against apixaban and enoxaparin (n=2,000), a real second indication refused as a layer on two grounds. Uptake: the seed's own refusal stands, since every anticoagulant launched into this use (Xarelto, Eliquis) files one CMS Part D line across AF, VTE treatment and post-arthroplasty prophylaxis, so no capture of the post-surgical pool can be measured. Engine: a pipeline asset carries one annual price and one discontinuation for every indication, so a short post-operative course would be charged the AF price (CMS Part D $4,706 a beneficiary-year) and carried at 78.7% persistence, which no cited figure supports

Phase 3 VTE thromboprophylaxis after total knee arthroplasty against aspirin (n=2,000), the sister study of NCT07015905 and refused on the same two grounds: no CMS line separates post-arthroplasty use from AF, and a pipeline asset prices every indication at one annual price and one persistence. Were a layer built, this readout would follow NCT07015905 on the same pool and decide nothing further

IZABRIGHT-Breast01, Phase 2/3 against chemotherapy in first-line metastatic TNBC not eligible for anti-PD-(L)1 (n=600), a real second indication refused as a layer, confirming the seed's filed refusal. Pool: SEER gives TNBC incidence (the 34,695 the Trodelvy row carries) but no free US source counts the patients who reach first-line metastatic treatment ineligible for anti-PD-(L)1. Uptake: the two products labelled in this line, Trodelvy and Datroway, each file one CMS Part B line across all their breast and lung indications, so no first-line capture can be measured

Phase 2 in bipolar I or II depression on a mood stabiliser (n=195), confirming the seed's filed refusal. The pool is citable (data/epidemiology.csv, Bipolar Disorder 3,776,689, NIMH) but the uptake is not: every recent branded launch in bipolar depression (Caplyta, Vraylar, Latuda) files one revenue and CMS line across schizophrenia, bipolar and MDD. Were it modelled, the MDD Phase 2 NCT07276997 (2027-09) would still decide the asset's gate first

Phase 2b/3 suprachoroidal sura-vec in diabetic retinopathy without centre-involved DME (n=576), a real second indication refused as a layer: no free source measures the uptake of any therapy in non-proliferative DR without CI-DME, because Eylea's NPDR claim shares one CMS Part B line (aflibercept) with wet AMD, DME and RVO. The seed's note that DR sits on a separate record, asset 1651, is stale: no asset 1651 exists and every DR study of the molecule is on this one

The registry's official title is 'A Phase 1b Dose Escalation and Expansion Study of IMGN151 as Monotherapy and in Combination With Other Anti-Cancer Therapies in Subjects With Gynecologic Cancers'; all six arms (A to F) give IMGN151, alone or with carboplatin, olaparib or bevacizumab, and the primary outcome is dose-limiting toxicities. It decides a dose and a partner, not whether a patient gets the drug, and its disease is the ovarian, fallopian tube and peritoneal cancer the book already values on Ovarian Neoplasms

CRYSTAL-1 is a Phase 2a with three separately filed cohorts (Narcolepsy Type 1, Narcolepsy Type 2, Idiopathic Hypersomnia), each ORX750 against placebo, and its primary outcome is treatment-emergent adverse events. The asset's gate is the Phase 2/3 SAPPHIRE (NCT07598708, 2027-09-30), and idiopathic hypersomnia is not modelled: SAPPHIRE enrols narcolepsy types 1 and 2 only and no Phase 3 in idiopathic hypersomnia is registered (data/assumptions/lly_cleminorexton.csv)

Phase 3 safety and immunogenicity of a single dose of PCV21 against 20vPCV in 100 children and adolescents aged 2 to 17 with sickle cell disease; the primary outcome is immediate adverse events. Sickle cell disease is the risk condition, not the indication: the vaccine prevents pneumococcal disease, the indication the book values, and the seed already names this study a high-risk subgroup of the same paediatric pool

A Phase 3 of mibavademab in obesity due to leptin (LEP) gene mutations in children, adolescents and adults, 4 participants estimated, condition 'Monogenic Obesity' (ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, read 2026-11-16). Biallelic LEP loss of function is a real expansion beyond the generalized lipodystrophy the seed models, but no free source gives a US count of the population, and a pool written under the registry's 'Obesity, Morbid' would enter the shared obesity pool of 107.6 million adults as a claimant (docs/research/gaps_2026-11-16/c_metabolic/verdicts.csv)

eVOLVE-Cervical, Phase 3 against placebo (800 planned) in FIGO 2018 stage IIIA to IVA cervical cancer that has not progressed after platinum chemoradiation, primary outcome PFS, primary completion 2027-11-26 (registry, last update 2026-11-10). A real second indication refused as a layer on three grounds. Pool: the study excludes 'Exposure to immune mediated therapy prior to the study for any indication' and 'Any prior (besides prior CCRT) or concurrent treatment for cervical cancer', and pembrolizumab is labelled 'in combination with chemoradiotherapy' for FIGO 2014 stage III-IVA disease (Keytruda label, DailyMed setid 9333c79b-d487-4538-a9f0-71b91a02b287, effective 2026-10-16), so the US pool is the stage III to IVA patients given chemoradiation without pembrolizumab, a share no free source measures. Uptake: Keytruda files one CMS Part B line across every indication (75,361 beneficiaries in 2024, drug_demand), so no capture of this setting by any checkpoint inhibitor can be read, and none other is labelled in it. Engine: an additions row on Uterine Cervical Neoplasms (D002583) would make this the asset's gate readout, because no NSCLC or mesothelioma Phase 3 readout is on its calendar, so it would carry the NSCLC value too and price a cervical miss at nil for the whole molecule

TRANSCEND, Phase 3 against placebo (132 enrolled) in kidney transplant recipients at least six months from transplant with biopsy-confirmed active or chronic active antibody-mediated rejection and HLA donor-specific antibody, primary outcome biopsy-proven histologic resolution at week 24, primary completion 2026-12-01 (registry, last update 2026-06-05). A real second indication refused as a layer on two grounds. Uptake: no therapy is approved for AMR ('no therapy has gained robust regulatory approval', Bohmig GA et al., Nephrol Dial Transplant 2025;40:1615-1627, PMID 40440205), so there is no launch to measure a capture from. Engine: MeSH has no AMR descriptor, and filing the study on Graft Rejection (D006084) would make TRANSCEND, which completes six months before PREVAIL (NCT06935357, 2027-05-31), the asset's gate readout: it would carry the IgAN value as well and price an AMR miss at nil for the whole molecule, though IgAN is a separate disease with its own Phase 3. Biogen values AMR as its own in-process R&D unit (FY2025 10-K 0000875045-26-000013, FelzartamabAMRMember), a shape this engine cannot give a pipeline asset

RENEW-ALC-1, Phase 3 against placebo (1,100 planned) in adults with moderate-to-severe alcohol use disorder who are seeking treatment, primary outcome change in drinking by timeline followback to week 56, primary completion 2028-04 (registry, last update 2026-10-07). A real second indication refused as a layer. The pool is citable: 27.1 million US adults had past-year AUD in 2024, of whom 7.5% (2.0 million) received alcohol use treatment and 2.4% (665,000) received medication (NSDUH 2024, Table 5.9A, as tabulated on NIAAA's alcohol use disorder and alcohol treatment statistics pages). Uptake is not: the only branded AUD launch, Vivitrol, files one net sales line across alcohol and opioid dependence ($467.9mm in 2025, Alkermes FY2025 10-K 0001193125-26-068925), and acamprosate, oral naltrexone and disulfiram are generic, so no launch's capture of the AUD pool can be measured. Overlap: on this pipeline asset the AUD pool's overlap with the treated MDD pool already valued (21,414,000 x 0.61) has to come out of eligible_pct, and this research found no free table splitting the AUD treatment pool by depression treatment. The gate is not the obstacle: the readout would be same_gate_later behind RENEW-MDD-1 (2028-02), a Phase 3 of the same stage. Re-checked 2026-11-27: Alkermes's 10-Q for the quarter to 2026-06-30 (0001193125-26-319022) still reports Vivitrol as one net sales line across alcohol and opioid dependence, with no split. Still unpriced

RENEW-ALC-2, Phase 3 against placebo (1,100 planned) in adults with alcohol use disorder of any severity who are seeking treatment, the twin of RENEW-ALC-1 (NCT07219966), primary outcome change in drinking by timeline followback to week 56, primary completion 2028-04 (registry, last update 2026-11-04). Refused as a layer on the grounds filed for RENEW-ALC-1: the pool is citable (27.1 million US adults with past-year AUD, NSDUH 2024) but no AUD launch's capture can be measured, since Vivitrol files one net sales line across alcohol and opioid dependence ($467.9mm in 2025, Alkermes FY2025 10-K 0001193125-26-068925) and the other AUD medicines are generic, and the overlap with the MDD pool already valued has no free split. OLYMPIA-4, Phase 3 (216 enrolled) of odronextamab against salvage chemoimmunotherapy then autologous transplant in aggressive B-cell lymphoma that is primary refractory or relapsed within 12 months of an anti-CD20 and anthracycline first line, with intent to transplant, primary outcome event-free survival, primary completion 2028-05-29 (registry, last update 2026-05-11). A real second-line indication refused as a layer. Pool: the DLBCL pool (19,046) is on file but no free source gives the share of diagnoses that are primary refractory or relapse within 12 months and are transplant-intended. The nearest, a Flatiron cohort of 10,016 first-line LBCL patients (Perales MA et al., Blood Adv 2026;10:5325-5337, PMID 42234934, PMC13449983), reports 30% starting any second line and a 205-patient second-line CAR T eligible cohort its authors call possibly undercaptured, neither a share of diagnoses. Uptake: the products labelled in this line, Yescarta and Breyanzi, file CMS Part B lines of 37 and 135 beneficiaries in 2024 (drug_demand), each across every line it is labelled in, so no second-line capture can be read; Perales gives 25.0% of clearly fit eligible patients receiving second-line CAR T, a share of the line and not a launch. The gate is not the obstacle: OLYMPIA-4 completes after OLYMPIA-1 (2028-02-29) and would be same_gate_later

Phase 2, 168 enrolled, JSB462 100 or 300 mg plus abiraterone against abiraterone or enzalutamide in high-volume metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, primary outcome PSA90 rate, primary completion 2026-12-03 per the registry (last update 2026-11-13), not the 2032-02-13 nvs_jsb462.csv carries. A real second indication refused as a layer on three grounds. MeSH: there is no hormone-sensitive descriptor, and the parent, Prostatic Neoplasms (D011471), carries the post-ARPI mCRPC pool this asset is valued on, so filing the study there would let an mHSPC result decide the mCRPC value. Persistence: a pipeline asset carries one discontinuation for every indication, and this one's 51.18% a year comes from Pluvicto's post-ARPI rPFS of 11.60 months; ARPI-treated mHSPC progresses far more slowly (abiraterone plus ADT in LATITUDE, median rPFS 33.0 months, Fizazi K et al., N Engl J Med 2017;377:352-360, PMID 28578607, about 22% a year at a constant hazard), so an mHSPC layer would be charged less than half its time on drug. Gate: this is the asset's only readout on the calendar (the mCRPC Phase 2 NCT07047118, 2027-07-16, has no catalyst row), so a layer would make it the gate for the whole molecule
